# VantaDB

> VantaDB is an embedded persistent memory and hybrid retrieval engine for AI
> agents. Rust core; Python, TypeScript/Node and WASM bindings; an HTTP API and
> an MCP server. Published to crates.io, PyPI and npm.

Every link below points to the raw Markdown source, not a rendered page. Read the
page you need; do not read this file end to end. This index covers the
451 documentation pages; it deliberately omits the 1071 task files,
which are work items rather than documentation. The full inventory of every file
is in docs/index.md in the repository.

## Start here

- [VantaDB Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/README.md): Welcome to the VantaDB documentation vault
- [API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/index.md): Section index.

- [End-user documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/index.md): Section index.

## Glossary

- [ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/ann.md): ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search) is a family of algorithms that find vectors similar to a query without examining all the vectors in the dataset, sacrificing accuracy for speed
- [Antes de cada interacción](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/ai-agents.md): AI agents are autonomous systems based on language models that can perceive their environment, make decisions and execute actions to achieve specific objectives, maintaining state and context over time
- [BM25 — Best Matching 25](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/bm25.md): BM25 (Best Matching 25) is a relevance ranking algorithm for full-text search. It is a probabilistic scoring function that classifies documents according to their relevance to a query, improving the classic TF-IDF model
- [Benchmarks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/benchmarks.md): Benchmarks are standardized performance tests that measure quantitative metrics (latency, throughput, recall) under controlled conditions, allowing objective comparisons and detection of regressions
- [Bincode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/bincode.md): Legacy dense binary encoding for Rust values, paired with serde derives. VantaDB
- [CI/CD ΓÇö Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/ci-cd.md): CI/CD is the practice of automating the integration, testing and deployment of code, allowing frequent and reliable releases through pipelines that validate each change before reaching production
- [CRDT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/crdt.md): Data types whose concurrent updates merge deterministically toward the same state
- [Compaction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/compaction.md): La compaction (compactaci├│n) es el proceso de reorganizar los datos en disco para eliminar registros obsoletos, fusionar archivos fragmentados y optimizar el rendimiento de lectura. En VantaDB existen dos tipos principales...
- [Embedded (Embedded Database)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/embedded.md): An embedded database is a data management system that operates in-process within the same application that consumes it, without requiring a separate server, network daemon, or independent process. The database is compiled as a library...
- [Failpoints](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/failpoints.md): Failpoints are error injection points inserted in the code that allow specific failures (I/O errors, timeouts, corruption) to be simulated in a controlled way during testing, validating error handling without the need for real failures
- [Grafo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/graph.md): A graph (or property graph) is a data structure composed of nodes (entities) and edges (relationships), where both can have associated properties. Graphs model connectivity and explicit relationships between entities, allowing traversal...
- [GraphRAG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/graphrag.md): GraphRAG (Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation) es una técnica avanzada de recuperación de información que combina RAG tradicional con traversal de Grafo de conocimiento para proporcionar contexto enriquecido y estructuralmente...
- [Heuristic Search](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/heuristic_search.md): El heuristic search (búsqueda heurística) en el contexto de VantaDB refiere al algoritmo de selección de vecinos definido en el paper de hnsw (Algorithm 4, Malkov & Yashunin 2018). Su propósito es maximizar la diversidad espacial de las...
- [Instalación](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/zero-config.md): Zero-Config is a design principle where software works correctly immediately after installation, without requiring configuration files, environment variables, external services, or manual setup steps
- [LSM-Tree—Log-Structured Merge-Tree](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/lsm-tree.md): A LSM-Tree (Log-Structured Merge-Tree) is a data structure optimized for sequential writes, which maintains data in memory (MemTable) and periodically dumps it to disk in immutable files (SSTables), with background compaction to...
- [LanceDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/lancedb.md): Embedded vector database on Arrow-based Lance storage, with table/schema semantics
- [Latencia](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/latency.md): La latencia es el tiempo que transcurre entre el inicio de una operación y su completitud. En bases de datos, se mide típicamente en milisegundos (ms) o microsegundos (µs)
- [Linux](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/fjall.md): Fjall is a lsm-tree (Log-Structured Merge-Tree) storage engine written in 100% secure Rust, designed to be embeddable, transactional and high-performance. It is the default canonical VantaDB backend since version 0.1.4
- [MCP (Model Context Protocol)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/mcp.md): MCP (Model Context Protocol) es un protocolo estándar abierto que permite a modelos de lenguaje (LLMs) y agentes de IA interactuar con herramientas y fuentes de datos externas de manera estructurada y segura
- [Memory Efficiency](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/memory-efficiency.md): La eficiencia de memoria mide cuánta RAM consume el sistema por cada elemento indexado. En bases de datos vectoriales, se expresa típicamente como bytes por vector
- [Multi-tenancy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/multi-tenancy.md): Multi-tenancy es una arquitectura donde una sola instancia de software sirve a múltiples clientes (tenants), manteniendo aislamiento de datos y configuración entre ellos
- [OIDC (OpenID Connect)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/oidc.md): OIDC (OpenID Connect) es un protocolo de autenticación basado en OAuth 2.0 que permite a aplicaciones verificar la identidad de usuarios y obtener información de perfil de manera segura
- [OpenTelemetry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/opentelemetry.md): Vendor-neutral APIs/SDKs for traces, metrics and logs
- [Payload Indexes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/payload-indexes.md): Los payload indexes son índices derivados sobre los campos de metadata de un
- [Persistencia](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/persistence.md): La persistencia es la capacidad de un sistema de almacenamiento de datos para mantener la información de forma duradera más allá del ciclo de vida del proceso que la creó. En bases de datos, esto implica garantizar que los datos...
- [Postcard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/postcard.md): Compact serde-based binary format used by VantaDB for WAL records, index metadata and SDK structures.
- [PyO3](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/pyo3.md): PyO3 es un framework de Rust para crear extensiones de Python y bindings bidireccionales entre Rust y Python. Permite exponer código Rust como módulos Python nativos, manteniendo seguridad de tipos y gestión de memoria automática
- [Python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/ffi.md): FFI (Foreign Function Interface) is a mechanism that allows code written in one programming language to call functions written in another language. In the context of VantaDB, FFI refers to the boundary between Rust (core engine) and...
- [Qdrant](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/qdrant.md): Rust vector search engine (client-server) used as competitive baseline in VantaDB benchmarks
- [RAG — Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/rag.md): RAG ​​(Retrieval-Augmented Generation) is an architectural pattern that combines an information retrieval system (retrieval) with a generative language model (LLM) to produce responses informed by domain-specific data, reducing...
- [RBAC (Role-Based Access Control)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/rbac.md): RBAC (Control de Acceso Basado en Roles) es un modelo de seguridad donde los permisos se asignan a roles, y los usuarios heredan permisos al ser asignados a roles
- [Recall](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/recall.md): El recall (también llamado sensibilidad o tasa de verdaderos positivos) es una métrica que mide la proporción de resultados relevantes que fueron recuperados exitosamente por el sistema
- [RocksDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/rocksdb.md): RocksDB is a high-performance lsm-tree storage engine developed by Facebook, written in C++. It is widely used in the industry as a storage backend for databases and distributed systems. In VantaDB, RocksDB is the fallback/alternative...
- [SDK Python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/python-sdk.md): El SDK Python de VantaDB es una interfaz de programación que permite a desarrolladores Python interactuar con el motor de base de datos embebido escrito en Rust, mediante bindings nativos generados con PyO3
- [SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/simd.md): SIMD es una clase de instrucciones de CPU que permiten procesar múltiples datos con una sola instrucción, paralelizando operaciones vectoriales a nivel de hardware
- [SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/slsa.md): SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts) es un framework de seguridad que define niveles de madurez para la cadena de suministro de software, desde código fuente hasta artefactos binarios
- [Serde](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/serde.md): De-facto Rust framework deriving Serialize/Deserialize for structured data
- [Serialization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/serialization.md): La serialización es el proceso de convertir estructuras de datos en memoria (structs, objetos) a un formato que pueda ser almacenado en disco o transmitido por red. La deserialización es el proceso inverso: reconstruir las estructuras...
- [Sigstore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/sigstore.md): Sigstore es un proyecto de seguridad de cadena de suministro de software que proporciona firma, verificación y transparencia de artefactos sin necesidad de gestionar claves criptográficas
- [Single-thread: 1 second](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/gil.md): The GIL (Global Interpreter Lock) is a global mutex in the CPython interpreter that protects access to Python objects, ensuring that only one thread can execute Python bytecode at a time within a process
- [Transactional](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/transactional.md): A transactional system guarantees that operations on data comply with the ACID properties (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability), ensuring that mutations are reliable even in the face of system failures, crashes or concurrency
- [Vectores](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/vectors.md): In the context of databases and ML, a vector is an array of floating point numbers (typically f32) that represents an object (text, image, audio) in a high-dimensional space. Vectors capture semantic similarity: similar objects have...
- [WASM](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/wasm.md): Portable binary format executing at near-native speed in browsers and edge runtimes
- [Zero-Copy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/zero-copy.md): Zero-Copy es una técnica de optimización que evita copiar datos entre buffers de memoria, accediendo directamente a la fuente de datos original
- [backpressure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/backpressure.md): Backpressure is a flow control mechanism that allows a system to signal its clients to reduce the rate of requests when it is under excessive load, preventing collapse due to resource exhaustion
- [busqueda-hibrida](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/hybrid-search.md): La busqueda-hibrida combina múltiples estrategias de recuperación (típicamente vectorial + léxica) para aprovechar las fortalezas de cada una y mejorar el recall general del sistema
- [busqueda-lexica](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/lexical-search.md): La busqueda-lexica es una técnica de recuperación de información basada en la coincidencia exacta de términos (keywords) entre la consulta y los documentos, utilizando modelos estadísticos como BM25 para calcular la relevancia
- [busqueda-vectorial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/hnsw.md): HNSW is an indexing algorithm for approximate nearest neighbor search (ANN) that constructs a multi-layer graph of vectors, allowing searches in logarithmic time ($O(\log N)$) with high recall (>0.95)
- [busqueda-vectorial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/vector-search.md): La busqueda-vectorial (o búsqueda por similitud semántica) es una técnica de recuperación de información que encuentra vectores en un espacio de alta dimensionalidad que son más similares a un vector de consulta según una métrica de...
- [chaos_test_wal.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/chaos-testing.md): Chaos Testing (or Chaos Engineering) is the practice of injecting controlled faults into a system to validate its resilience and recovery, ensuring that it behaves correctly under adverse conditions
- [crc32c](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/crc32c.md): CRC32C is a checksum algorithm that produces a 32-bit hash using the Castagnoli polynomial. It is used to detect data corruption in storage and transmission, with hardware support on modern CPUs (SSE4.2, ARM CRC)
- [dashmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/dashmap.md): DashMap is a concurrent and sharded HashMap implementation for Rust that allows parallel access without the need for a global lock
- [file-locking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/file-locking.md): Mitigation: Implement advisory lock in open()
- [fsync — File Synchronization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/fsync.md): fsync is an operating system syscall that forces the writing of all in-memory buffers to the physical disk, ensuring that data is persistently stored and survives power outages or system crashes
- [local-first](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/local-first.md): Local-First is a software design philosophy that prioritizes data and processing occurring on the user's device, with the cloud as an optional backup and not a requirement. The software works completely offline and synchronization is an...
- [mmap — Memory-Mapped I/O](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/mmap.md): mmap (memory mapping) is an operating system syscall that maps a disk file directly to the virtual address space of a process, allowing access to the contents of the file as if it were RAM, without explicit copies
- [mvcc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/mvcc.md): MVCC is a method of concurrency control where each transaction sees a consistent snapshot of the database, allowing readers and writers to operate simultaneously without blocking each other
- [put_batch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/put_batch.md): putbatch es un método de la API de VantaDB que inserta o actualiza múltiples registros de memoria persistentes en una sola operación. Utiliza paralelismo vía Rayon para procesar los registros concurrentemente
- [rrf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/rrf.md): RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion) is an algorithm to merge multiple ranking lists into a unified ranking, based solely on the ordinal position (rank) of each document in each list, without the need to normalize heterogeneous scores
- [rwlock](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/rwlock.md): Description: rebuildindex() does not acquire an exclusive lock, allowing concurrent reads during rebuild
- [similar_to_key](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/similar_to_key.md): similartokey es un método de la API de VantaDB que permite buscar registros similares a uno existente, identificado por su clave (namespace + key). Internamente obtiene el vector del registro origen y ejecuta una búsqueda vector-search...
- [vector-similarity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/vector-similarity.md): Vector Similarity refers to the mathematical metrics used to measure how similar two vectors are in a high-dimensional space. It is the basis of vector-search in hnsw
- [wal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/glosario/wal.md): VantaDB uses a sharded WAL (ShardedWal) that distributes records in round-robin fashion across N shard files to reduce contention and improve write throughput

## API reference

- [Bindings Namespace Map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/BINDINGS_NAMESPACES.md): Rules for the migration window
- [Certified delete - purge certificates (VER-02)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/CERTIFIED_DELETE.md): Per-surface purge certificate emitted by delete (CLI/MCP/Rust): residue inventory for store, JSON-shredded metadata, indexes and WAL tombstone; integrity hash, VER-01 chain reference and documented limits (logical vs physical purge, backups, exports)
- [Compatibility Matrix & 1.0 Readiness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/COMPATIBILITY.md): What each public API surface promises, how that promise is enforced
- [Deprecations Registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/DEPRECATIONS.md): Concrete deprecations of the public API surfaces and their removal windows
- [Embedded SDK Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/EMBEDDED_SDK.md): Source: src/sdk/mod.rs, src/sdk/builder.rs, src/sdk/api/.rs, src/sdk/graph.rs, src/sdk/search/mod.rs
- [Embeddings — BYO-Vector + embed-local](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/EMBEDDINGS.md): VantaDB is BYO-vector by default (“does not embed text for you”) and offers an opt-in local embedding path via the embed-local Cargo feature. No breaking changes — EmbeddingProvider is additive
- [GraphRAG API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/GRAPH_RAG.md): GraphRAG (seed → expand → retrieve → context) is exposed by the Rust SDK and all four bindings — Python, WASM, TypeScript and Node — with one canonical wire shape
- [Memory interchange format (JSONL v2)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/MEMORY_INTERCHANGE_FORMAT.md): The JSONL v2 contract shared by VantaDB export, import and the third-party importers (Mem0, Zep/Graphiti, Letta), with mapping tables and declared limits
- [Node.js Native SDK Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/NODE_SDK.md): vantadb-node is the native Node.js binding for VantaDB, built with
- [Python SDK Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/PYTHON_SDK.md): Python SDK reference — Client, memory records, cognitive layer (memory_capture/memory_recall), async client and typed errors
- [Scoring Semantics — VantaDB Official Score Contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/scores.md): VantaDB hybrid search combines two independent rankers
- [Search Capability Parity — VantaDB vs Milvus vs Qdrant](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/SEARCH_PARITY.md): 1. topk semantics under groupby — VantaDB caps total hits; Milvus/Qdrant cap the number of groups. Choose topk = groups × groupsize to emulate the vendor behavior
- [TypeScript SDK Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/TS_SDK.md): Create a new in-memory instance. Accepts an optional Config object. To use persistent storage, call connect() or open() instead
- [Vanta Memory Engine — API Reference (`vanta-memory`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/VANTA_MEMORY.md): Crate LLM-driven para memoria de agentes: captura L0, extracción/dedup L1, escenas L2,
- [VantaDB Error Handling Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/ERROR_HANDLING.md): This is the canonical contract for how VantaDB surfaces errors across every
- [VantaDB HTTP API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/HTTP_API.md): Default: http://127.0.0.1:8080
- [VantaDB IQL Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/IQL.md): The parser implements IQL version 2 (adds the AS OF valid-time clause). The version is exposed as IQL_VERSION
- [VantaDB Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/MCP.md): MCP server reference — tools, profiles, and the current implementation version (tracked below)
- [Versioning & Stability Policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/VERSIONING.md): VantaDB follows Semantic Versioning with the standard
- [WAL Integrity — tamper-evident hash-chain](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WAL_INTEGRITY.md): Hash-chain per WAL record (VER-01): detects altered, removed or reordered frames with exact position; documented limits (suffix truncation, consistent rewrite, archived segments) and on-demand detection via vanta-cli verify
- [WASM API Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WASM_API.md): This page is the canonical entry point for VantaDB's WebAssembly surface — the
- [WASM Persistence Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WASM_PERSISTENCE.md): How VantaDB persists data in the browser: what exists, what the verified
- [WASM Standalone Console (Vanta Studio — mode `wasm`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WASM_STANDALONE.md): The Vanta Studio console can run 100% in the browser with no server: the
- [vanta-proxy Reference (Endpoints, Opt-in Features, Config)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/PROXY.md): vanta-proxy is a transparent LLM wire proxy: by default it forwards bytes

## Reports

- [Benchmark Optimization — VantaDB 2026](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/benchmarks/docs/BENCHMARK_OPTIMIZATION_2026.md): Conclusión: CPU con AVX2 + FMA, sin AVX-512. El runtime dispatch en distance.rs usará kernels f32x8 (AVX2) para todas las operaciones
- [DORA Flow Metrics Report](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/reports/dora.md): Δt promedio (solo fallos reales, exit ≠ -1): 0.6h sobre 21 pares (17 espurios excluidos del promedio)
- [Pipeline Evaluation Report](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/reports/pipeline-evals.md)
- [Pipeline Evaluation Report](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/reports/pipeline-evals.md): Métricas del pipeline vs North Star (RULES.md) — verify calls, primer intento, regresiones — generado por evals/eval-metrics.mjs
- [VantaDB Competitive Analysis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/benchmarks/COMPETITIVE_ANALYSIS.md): De 184 QPS → 3,157 QPS (GloVe baseline pre-regresión). Empate técnico con ChromaDB (~2,905 vs ~2,981 QPS GloVe)
- [VantaDB Competitive SDK Benchmark — Honest Results (PERF-03)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/benchmarks/COMPETITIVE_SDK_BENCH.md): python benchmarks/competitivebench.py --engines milvus --dataset synthetic --size 2000 --queries 50 --json-output docs/user/benchmarks/competitivesdkbenchmilvus.json --output benchmarks/n.md --yes

- [`release-wheels.yml` — RELEASE: Wheels — Build & Publish](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/workflow/release-wheels-60.md): Construye, prueba y publica los wheels Python (vantadb-py) para Linux, macOS y Windows. Incluye smoke tests de importación y funcionales, y verificación de build provenance
- [`sec-codeql.yml` — SEC: CodeQL — Analysis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/workflow/sec-codeql-30.md): Ejecuta el análisis estático de seguridad CodeQL de GitHub sobre el código Rust del proyecto para detectar vulnerabilidades
- [Fuzzing Guide for VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/operations/FUZZING.md): VantaDB uses a dual fuzzing approach to maximize coverage and compatibility

## Tutorials

- [Building AI Agent Memory with VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/01-ai-agent-memory.md): VantaDB gives AI agents persistent memory — the ability to store, recall, and search across past conversations, decisions, and context. Unlike stateless LLM calls, an agent backed by VantaDB remembers what happened last session...
- [Embedding Integrations — BYO-Vector + embed-local](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/05-embedding-integrations.md): VantaDB does not embed text for you by default. This is intentional (BYO-vector): you control the embedding model, dimension, and lifecycle. Bring your own vector=[...] on put() and queryvector on search()
- [Hybrid Search with VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/04-hybrid-search-basics.md): Vector search finds meaning; keyword search finds exact terms. Most real queries need both. VantaDB fuses HNSW vector search with BM25 lexical search in a single call, so you get semantic recall and precise term matching without running...
- [LM Studio + VantaDB — Persistent Memory for Your Local GUI Stack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/06-lm-studio.md): Pattern tutorial: apps consuming LM Studio's OpenAI-compatible local server + VantaDB as persistent, searchable memory (rescued from the 2026-06 GTM research, updated to 0.7.x API).
- [Local RAG Pipeline with VantaDB + Ollama](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/02-local-rag-pipeline.md): Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) lets you ask natural language questions over your own documents — without sending data to a third-party API. This tutorial builds a fully local RAG pipeline using
- [Migrating from ChromaDB to VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/03-migrating-from-chromadb.md): If you're using ChromaDB today, switching to VantaDB unlocks graph edges, MCP protocol support, WASM browser runtime, and hybrid search — while keeping your existing vector workflow. This tutorial shows the exact API mappings and...
- [Migrating from LanceDB to VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/migration-from-lancedb.md): If you're using LanceDB today, switching to VantaDB unlocks GraphRAG traversal, built-in hybrid search (BM25 + HNSW), TTL-based record expiry, and the VantaDB PyPI integration ecosystem — while keeping your existing vector workflow...

- [Migrating from Mem0 to VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/migrating-from-mem0.md): Export your Mem0 memories without credentials, convert them with the built-in importer, and import them into VantaDB — metadata, timestamps and provenance preserved

If you were on the self-service tier, you need a new home for your corpora. VantaDB is a drop-in local-first replacement...
